symbols: Target conditional ownership state and transitions
implementation: Retain existing public Registry and Authority APIs and ordinary ownership semantics.
Bind immutable external human-idle and views-backgrounded conditions to the current live native human owner and generation.
Expose monotonic eligibility, consent, warning, daemon-clock and actual settlement facts in public snapshots and private claim reads.
Require original live native attachment consent for the exact activity revision and view serial that were displayed.
Preserve the identical human control handle through warning, settlement drain, offer, keep and conditional withdrawal.
Revalidate owner, generation, condition, consent, activity, views, requested warning and exact settlement atomically at acceptance.
Retract conditional offers and consent on relevant activity, view, focus or membership changes; stale offers cannot become current again.
Use consent-recorded and aborted-by-owner protocol transitions; keep is terminal for that explicit request and does not rearm policy.
Ordinary cancellation grants nobody; explicit release supersedes conditional intent; no implicit external reacquisition policy.
Keep unknown native-input calls blocking. Generic settlement cannot certify native input as applied or rejected.
Bound superseded conditional offer tombstones to 32.
Keep controller registration and all native authority operations on the original persistent connection, owned by one FIFO worker.
Use a bounded 128-operation queue and three-second RPC timeout; move input payloads and share immutable cached grants rather than clone capability JSON for every key.
Refresh controller, private pending claims and public state without blocking the TUI event loop; require committed controller identity and generation before enabling application input.

Implement explicit request, retained waiting state, hide/reopen, deliberate cancel, deliberate Force, observed-facts confirmation, owner yield/release and automatic acceptance of the requester's exact ready safe offer.
Show real retained blockers with identity, kind, elapsed time and outcome, with scrolling rather than a timeout-based grant.
Gate every application-bound key, repeat, literal prefix, paste and application mouse event. Intercepted input is discarded, not buffered for replay.
Suppress an intercepted mouse gesture through drag and release even if authority changes during the gesture.
Render requested conditional timing before consent; retain the precise displayed activity revision and view serial; never consent from an undisplayed or clipped warning.
Process warning acknowledgement and Keep on the same connection before later paste, mouse or local activity; clear pending prefix/modal input when consuming Keep.
Handle all relevant conditional warnings, not only whichever request is currently selected in the panel.
Sanitize control and bidi characters, clip Unicode labels and include disambiguating controller IDs without displaying private handles.
Render ownership and conditional status in the existing three header rows; preserve the single application surface, picker, search, diagnostics and scrollback hints.
Fail closed on stale authority or connection uncertainty; no reconnect, input retry or automatic reacquisition from a stale cached grant.
Replace the old synchronous minimal native controller and direct send_input paths with the dedicated native control module.
Keep the attachment's original connection in the authority worker and use a separate unregistered observer connection for ordinary screen/topology operations.
Route all application-bound input through the same authority gate and preserve local picker, selection and scrollback behavior.
Add configured-prefix Ctrl-L request/reopen/owner panel and Ctrl-F deliberate Force entry.
Start focus as unknown and defer view reports until already queued local events are drained; report real activity and consent in connection order.
Draw the existing native application surface before the control chrome; acknowledge conditional warnings only after an actual complete draw and after queued local events are handled.
Remove the obsolete implementation-specific old cache unit test; behavior coverage is in the actual authority and native fixtures.
Include tests/pty_control/native.rs in the existing pty_control integration target.
Bound post-kill CLI and private-daemon reaping instead of unconditionally waiting forever. Cleanup only signals fixture-owned processes and process groups.
Launch actual amux attach processes under openpty, setsid and TIOCSCTTY, with private HOME/config/runtime and the real private daemon.
Continuously drain each outer PTY on its own nonblocking reader thread, even while the test waits on another attachment, a daemon operation, a consent barrier or elapsed warning.
Parse the real ANSI stream with the existing alacritty_terminal dependency; snapshot text, raw ANSI and the three header rows' cell colors.

Keep capture-file I/O outside the reader lock. Limit retained raw evidence to 16 MiB; overflow is an explicit fixture failure while reading and parsing continue, not silent truncation or PTY backpressure.
Use a plain local byte-observable shell/cat target; no live model, Codex application or replacement conversation surface.
Use a transparent private socket proxy to delay the real consent reply and inspect Keep-before-paste ordering on the original native connection.

Bound attachment process reaping and reader joins to three seconds each after cancellation. Proxy shutdown releases consent barriers, shuts down owned streams, and joins only workers observed finished, with three-second deadlines. Cleanup deadline failures are visible; unwinding does not trigger a second panic.
Write capture artifacts only when parent executes the fixtures, under target/e03-native-captures/<private-host-id>/<attachment-name>/. No runtime captures were produced here.
Record this native-only implementation handoff without changing shared state, documentation, ledgers or acceptance status.

Verify delayed consent acknowledges the displayed revisions on the original connection, Keep precedes later allowed input, and owner handle identity remains unchanged through Keep/withdrawal.

Unknown native settlement intentionally remains blocking. The empty-ledger safe-yield fixture is not a substitute for final complete-broker settlement/fence validation, and Force is not evidence of safe acceptance.
